title: MAIN STORYLINE: STORMWATCH OPEN
lines: 01 NEW MAIN STORYLINE OPEN: STORMWATCH
STARTS FROM: March 17, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 3-8
02 LIMITED-TIME HEADHUNTING OPEN – SAILEACH ON THE HILL
DURATION: March 17, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) – March 31, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, the Limited-time Headhunting, "Saileach on The Hill", opens and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate from this Standard Headhunting:
★★★★★★: Saileach
★★★★★: Mulberry
★★★★: Roberta
03 NEW OPERATORS AVAILABLE IN HEADHUNTING
DETAILS: The following Operators will appear at Headhunting "Saileach on The Hill", and will be permanently added to other Headhunting after in future update.
★★★★★★: Saileach
★★★★★: Mulberry
★★★★: Roberta
NOTE:
Saileach, Mulberry, and Roberta will gain more trust during this event.
04 LIMITED-TIME LOGIN EVENT: PINING FOR HOME OPEN
DURATION: March 17, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) – March 26, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, players can login for 7 days to earn the following rewards.
Day 1: Regal Hanging Chair * 1, Top Emergency Sanity Potion * 1
Day 2: Orundum * 200, Strategic Battle Record * 25
Day 3: LMD * 30000, Pure Gold * 20
Day 4: Originite Prime * 1, Recruitment Permit * 5
Day 5: Tea Ceremony Table * 1, Skill Summary - 3 * 10
Day 6: Orundum * 200, Furniture Part * 300
Day 7: 'Shining Steps' Collection – Sing a Song for Pinecone * 1, LMD * 30000
NOTE:
The Top Emergency Sanity Potion from this event will be expired on April 4, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
Players can earn all the rewards even without login consecutively.
05 ALL STAGES SPECIAL DROP FOR A LIMITED-TIME
DURATION: March 17, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) - March 31, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, the following items will be added to all Sanity consuming stages (except Annihilation stages) as the special drops for a limited time:
Emergency Sanity Sampler
Rhodes Island Supplies
NOTE:
The Emergency Sanity Sampler from this event will be expired on April 11, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
06 'SHINING STEPS' COLLECTION NEW ARRIVALS AT OUTFIT STORE
DURATION: March 17, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) - March 31, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following Outfits will be available at the Store, including:
'Shining Steps' Collection – Publicity Strategy for Archetto
'Shining Steps' Collection – Frlibe on the Palace for Astesia
07 VITAFIELD [FORUINER] SERIES CLASSICS RE-EDITION AT OUTFIT STORE
DURATION: March 17, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) - March 31, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following Re-edition Outfits will be available at the Store, including:
Vitafield [Foruiner] Series Classics - Lostlands Flowering for Suzuran
Vitafield [Foruiner] Series Classics - Finder in the Rough for Leonhardt
Vitafield [Foruiner] Series Classics - Faraway Gaze for April
08 NEW FURNITURE SET - ROYAL GUARD ACADEMY DORMITORY
DURATION: March 17, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) - March 31, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: A brand new set of themed Furniture, Royal Guard Academy Dormitory, will be available at the Store from March 17, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) - March 31, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7).
